edges.name: respiratory_to_acid_base
edges.rationale: ventilation and oxygenation state should help acid-base and lactate trajectories

edges.name: endocrine_to_electrolyte
edges.rationale: glycemic/osmotic state and insulin/dextrose evidence should help electrolyte trajectories

edges.name: heme_to_perfusion
edges.rationale: oxygen-carrying capacity, coagulation, and transfusion evidence should help perfusion targets

edges.rationale: perfusion and hemodynamic support should help short-horizon renal output markers

edges.name: hepatic_to_coagulation_platelets
edges.rationale: hepatic failure state should help downstream platelet/coagulation-proxy and renal-acid-base targets

edges.name: immune_to_hemodynamics
edges.rationale: inflammatory state should help hemodynamic, platelet, and albumin trajectories
